＜Material Save 1＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place 1 card in this Digimon's DigiXros requirements from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)
[On Play] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 2000 DP or less.
